meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Weekly reserves and daily rates are final on release. Investment flows, ECBs and LRS are revised in later Bulletins; external debt is provisional for a quarter, then partially revised.
meta.product: Monthly average exchange rates, 155 currencies (DBIE report 720)
meta.coverage: The rupee against every currency the RBI quotes, monthly average
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 720, rupees per unit of each currency as published (some currencies are quoted per 100 units; the label names the currency, not the quotation unit). Currencies enter and leave the table over the years. A few codes carry two currency names with different rates (SKK as both 'Slovak koruna' and 'koruna'); each name is kept as its own series, as published.
